description: Ranked list of metros from the Global Metro Power Rankings composite, optionally filtered by region or country. Returns lightweight summary rows (rank, slug, name, country, region, score, population). Call get_metro for full detail on any one metro. Capped at 200 rows per call.

country.description: Filter by country name, e.g. 'United States'

n.description: Number of metros to return, max 200

region.description: Filter by region name, e.g. 'North America', 'Europe'

name: list_top_metros
title: List top metros
